be00051 3.paragraph: Explore what we believe, grounded in Scripture and centred on Jesus.

bc00038 37.paragraph: God is the Creator and Ruler of the universe. He exists eternally as three persons: the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. These three are equal and are one God.

bc0003d 49.paragraph: Jesus Christ is the Son of God and is equal with the Father. Jesus lived a sinless life on earth and offered Himself as the perfect sacrifice, dying on the cross for all humanity. He rose from the dead after three days, demonstrating His power over sin and death. He ascended to heavenly glory and will return to earth as King of kings and Lord of lords.

bc00040 51.paragraph: Matthew 1:22-23; Isaiah 9:6; John 1:1-5, 14:10-30; Hebrews 4:14,15; 1 Corinthians 15:3-4; Romans 1:3-4; Acts 1:9-11; 1 Timothy 6:14; Titus 2:13

bc00042 61.paragraph: The Holy Spirit is equal with the Father and the Son. He is present in the world to help people know Christ, and He lives in every Christian from the moment of salvation. He gives believers power for daily living, understanding of spiritual truth and guidance for the way ahead. He gives spiritual gifts to every believer. As Christians, we seek daily to live under the Holy Spirit’s direction.

bc00045 63.paragraph: 2 Corinthians 3:17; John 16:7-13, 14:16-17; Acts 1:8; 1 Corinthians 2:12; 3:16 Ephesians 1:13,5:18; Galatians 5:25

bc00047 73.paragraph: The Bible is God’s Word to us, written by people under the supernatural guidance of the Holy Spirit. It is the highest authority for Christian faith and life.

bc0004c 85.paragraph: Human beings were created in God’s spiritual image, reflecting His character. Humanity is the pinnacle of God’s creation. Although every person has the potential for good, our sinful attitudes separate us from God and bring many problems into our lives.

bc00051 97.paragraph: Salvation is God’s free gift, which we must receive. We can never atone for our sins through good works or self-improvement. Only through Jesus Christ and God’s forgiveness can we be delivered from the penalty of sin. We are saved when we turn in faith to Jesus from a self-centred life lived in our own strength. Eternal life begins when we receive the life of Jesus Christ by faith.

bc00056 109.paragraph: Because God gives us eternal life through Jesus Christ, true believers have eternal assurance of salvation. Salvation comes through God’s power and grace, not through a Christian’s own efforts. His preserving power and grace give us this lasting assurance. Believers also have a responsibility to continue trusting God and living in His care.

bc00059 111.paragraph: John 10:29; 2 Timothy 1:12; Hebrews 7:25, 10:10,14; 1 Peter 1:3-5; Hebrews 6:4-8; Hebrews 10:26-27; John 15:6

bc0005b 121.paragraph: People were created to exist forever. We will either be eternally separated from God because of sin, or live eternally with Him through forgiveness and salvation. Eternal separation from God is hell; eternal life is being with God forever.
